description: Publish to Medium without an API token. Medium closed its API to new integrations in Jan 2025, so this skill uses the one stable path left: it writes your post as Medium-ready HTML, deploys it to your own GitHub Pages, and uses Medium's URL importer to create a draft. Say 'blog about X' and it scaffolds your blog repo on first run, then drafts each post end to end. It always stops at a draft for your review and never auto-publishes. Needs GitHub, Medium, and the gh CLI.
